slides.texte_overlay:
7 ways to completely transform
yourself in half a year
Fix your mornings first. Same wake-up time, no phone for the first hour, a real breakfast. Six months of good mornings changes everything that comes after.
Learn one serious skill. Coding, a language, an instrument, design. Thirty minutes a day for six months is enough to become genuinely good at something.
Cut alcohol down to weekends. Better sleep, clearer skin, more energy and more money. Most men are shocked by how different they feel after a few months.
Train with a plan, not just vibes. Three structured workouts a week, tracking every lift. Progress you can see keeps you motivated for the long run.
Feed your mind on purpose. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and half a year of tiny lessons changed how I think and talk.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Half a year of tiny lessons changed how I think and talk.

slides.texte_overlay: Upgrade your circle. Spend more time with people who are growing and less with people who drag you down. You slowly become like the people around you.
Document the journey. A photo and a short note every month. Looking back after six months shows how far you've come, even on days it doesn't feel like it.
